title: Lively 'Mons: Starters-B-Gone
description: Entirely removes the Lively 'Mons Starters from the starter selection screen. Mainly used for people who want custom starters.
body:
## Starters-B-Gone™
Have **YOU** ever been making custom starters with Lively 'Mons, but they just won't go away? Well worry no more, because with _Starters-B-Gone™_ all of the starters added by Lively 'Mons will just **disappear**!

![How it works!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a140a3cfb8afa5bf230effe49322e4d20a42615.png)

_Starters-B-Gone™ is not for fixing the issue where **only** Lively 'Mons starters appear, that is answered on the Lively 'Mons Modrinth page. Consult your doctor before using Starters-B-Gone™ (Don't actually)._

---

The main usage of Starters-B-Gone is for creators and server owners who want to use both custom starters and Lively 'Mons without using the base Lively 'Mons starters.
